units.source_text: 做主人的妹尼僧只得出来稍稍应酬，

en.t: The younger nun who was acting as hostess had no choice but to come out and offer a few polite words,

units.source_text: 对小君说：“你姐姐想是被鬼怪迷住了，

en.t: and she said to Kogimi, "Your sister seems to have been possessed by some spirit,

units.source_text: 竟没有一刻爽健的时候，常是疾病缠绵。

en.t: for she has not had a single moment of health and is constantly lingering in illness.

units.source_text: 自从削发为尼之后，深恐被人找到，

en.t: Ever since she cut her hair and became a nun, she has been terribly afraid that someone might find her,

units.source_text: 引起种种烦恼。

en.t: and that this would bring all sorts of distress.

units.source_text: 我看了这模样甚是担心。

en.t: Seeing her in such a state has made me deeply worried.

units.source_text: 果然不出所料，今天知道她有这许多伤心失意之事，

en.t: As I feared, today I learned that she has had so many sorrows and disappointments,

units.source_text: 实在对不起薰大将了！

en.t: and I truly feel sorry toward General Kaoru!

units.source_text: 近来她一直心情恶劣，

en.t: Lately she has been in a very poor state of mind,

units.source_text: 大约是看了来信更添烦恼之故吧，

en.t: probably because reading the letter has added still more to her troubles,

units.source_text: 今天比往常更加神志不清了。”

en.t: and today she is even more confused than usual."

units.source_text: 便照山乡风习招待小君饮食。

en.t: Then she entertained Kogimi with food and drink according to the customs of the mountain village.

units.source_text: 小君的童心中但觉意兴索然，惶惑不安。

en.t: In his childish heart, Kogimi felt only disappointment, bewilderment, and unease.

units.source_text: 他说：“我特地奉使前来，

en.t: He said, "I came all this way on a special errand,

units.source_text: 归去将何以复命？

en.t: so what am I to report when I return?

units.source_text: 但得一句话也就好了。”

en.t: Even a single word from her would be enough."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“言之有理。”

en.t: The younger nun said, "You are quite right."

units.source_text: 便将小君之言转告浮舟。

en.t: She then relayed Kogimi's words to Ukifune.

units.source_text: 但浮舟一言不发。

en.t: But Ukifune did not utter a single word.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧无可奈何，出来对小君说道：“你只能回去说‘本人神志不清’了。

en.t: Having no other choice, the younger nun came out and said to Kogimi, "You can only go back and say, 'She is not in her right mind.'

units.source_text: 此间山风虽烈，但离京都不远，

en.t: Although the mountain winds are fierce here, it is not far from the capital,

units.source_text: 务请以后再来。”

en.t: so please be sure to come again another time."

units.source_text: 小君觉得空自久留在此，毫无意趣，便告辞返京。

en.t: Kogimi felt there was no point or pleasure in lingering there any longer, so he took his leave and returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 他私心爱慕这姐姐而终于不得会面，

en.t: In his heart he admired this elder sister, yet in the end he had not been able to meet her,

units.source_text: 又是懊丧，又是惋惜，

en.t: and he felt both dejected and full of regret,

units.source_text: 满怀怨恨地回来见薰大将。

en.t: returning to see General Kaoru with his heart full of resentment.

units.source_text: 薰大将正在盼待小君早归，

en.t: General Kaoru had been anxiously waiting for Kogimi to return quickly,

units.source_text: 看见他垂头丧气地回来，觉得特地遣使，反而扫兴。

en.t: but when he saw him come back downcast, he felt that sending him specially had only spoiled his hopes.

units.source_text: 他左思右想，不禁猜测：自己从前曾经把她藏匿在宇治山庄中，

en.t: As he thought it over again and again, he could not help wondering: since he himself had once hidden her away at his mountain villa in Uji,

units.source_text: 现在或许另有男子模仿了他，

en.t: perhaps now another man had imitated him,

units.source_text: 把她藏匿在这小野草庵中吧？

en.t: and was hiding her in this thatched hut at Ono.
